CHANDAN KUMAR SAHOO 
Senior Analyst, Trade Support | Mortgage-Backed Securities | Fixed Income Operations 
+91- 9819273694 | chandanchiku1234@gmail.com | Mumbai, India 
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
Trade Support professional with 3+ years in Fixed Income Operations, specializing in Mortgage-Backed Securities settlement and trade 
lifecycle management. Promoted to Senior Analyst within two years for consistently error-free execution under high-volume 
conditions. Known for turning manual, error-prone processes into automated, audit-ready workflows, and for being the steady point of 
contact onshore teams and clients trust during escalations. Looking to bring the same operational discipline to a larger fixed income or 
capital markets operations team. 
CORE SKILLS 
Trade Support & Settlement: MBS Trade Processing, Trade Lifecycle Management, AOT (Buy/Sell), TBA Netting Cycle, FICC/DTCC 
Platform, Trade Booking & Matching, Trade Break Resolution, Trade Reconciliation, Settlement Operations 
Markets Knowledge: Fixed Income Securities, Mortgage-Backed Securities, Capital Markets, Derivatives 
Tools & Technology: MS Excel (Advanced — VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, VBA/Macros), MS Word, MS PowerPoint 
Other: Process Improvement, Workflow Automation, Risk Mitigation, Client & Stakeholder Communication, High-Volume Transaction 
Management, Escalation Management 
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE 
eClerx, Mumbai 
Senior Analyst — Trade Support (Mortgage-Backed Securities) 
July 2025 – July 2026 
• Promoted to Senior Analyst in July 2025 in recognition of consistent accuracy, process improvement contributions, and reliability in 
high-volume MBS trade support. 
• Own end-to-end Buy/Sell AOT processing for Mortgage-Backed Securities with zero processing errors across 1,000+ trades per 
month, ensuring accurate trade booking and matching via the FICC (DTCC) platform. 
• Serve as primary point of contact for onshore teams and clients on complex trade breaks, discrepancies, and escalations, reducing 
resolution turnaround time. 
• Developed Excel VBA-based automation for AOT processing that reduced manual effort by 15%, improved turnaround time, and 
minimized operational risk. 
• Supported OTC and Fixed Income trade lifecycle activities, including trade booking, validation, confirmation, matching, 
settlement and exception management.  
• Coordinated with Front Office, Sales, clients and onshore teams to resolve OTC trade discrepancies, breaks and settlement issues.  
• Performed trade reconciliation and break resolution by investigating mismatches in trade economics, counterparty details, settlement 
instructions and transaction status.  
• Managed post-trade processing for OTC transactions, ensuring accurate trade capture, timely confirmation and settlement within 
defined SLAs

• Partnered with onshore teams and clients to identify and resolve trade breaks, discrepancies, and escalations, improving client

• Developed automation tools to streamline AOT processing and reduce manual intervention. 
• Recognised with the Hall of Fame Award (June 2024) and Employee of the Quarter Award (March 2025) for consistent accuracy
